title: Learn entry vocabulary — authored-sample task family speaks the product's words
reference: Apple HIG Writing → inclusivity principle: 'Write for everyone. … simple, plain language … avoiding jargon.'
law: The entry task buttons, the empty state and the authored-mathematics view use the product vocabulary 'example lesson(s)' in en/hi/bn; the honest boundary sentence survives ('These example lessons are not official curriculum coverage.'); no visible entry word contains 'sample' or 'legacy'; internal ?legacy=1 URLs and SAMPLE_SELECTION / PROFESSIONAL_SAMPLE_SELECTION / SAMPLE_LIBRARY_SELECTION behaviors stay untouched.

matrix.persona: fresh learner (Personal · Learner), real register→onboarding journey
matrix.expected: old fixture vocabulary visible: 'Try authored learning sample', 'Try a multi-book sample'

matrix.persona: fresh learner (Personal · Learner), real register→onboarding journey

clicking 'Try an example lesson' opens the authored sample outline
clicking 'Try examples from more books' opens the sample library selection
matrix.result: Sample library · 6 with Books · 2 (Fractions workbook + Geometry workbook) opened (catalogueBoard=Sample library)

matrix.expected: the honest label 'Open previous saved topics and examples' still reaches the internal legacy view (?legacy=1) with behaviors intact
matrix.result: navigated to /dashboard/learn?legacy=1; legacy Learn view renders (Guided journeys · curated interactive examples)

notes: Earlier same-day probe runs are superseded: they used a teacher persona (probe self-leak — a fallback clicked 'I am a Teacher' after 'I am a Learner') and were re-run with the learner persona; the committed set is the learner set. The wizard has two real variants (4-step, 5-step); the probe handles both via level-escalating card clicks.
